coreClaim: Conversation and Roleplay LLM generation on the Pi remains intact while a sleeping phone temporarily stops draining the remote SSE response, without restoring unbounded server buffering.

inScope: Bounded buffering while an HTTP reader is stalled
Ordered delivery after the reader resumes
Conversation and Roleplay callers of the shared remote LLM stream
outOfScope: Dropped TCP connections that require resumable server jobs

claimBoundary.coreClaim: A temporarily stalled remote LLM SSE reader no longer turns bounded-channel backpressure into an upstream generation failure; queued events remain ordered and byte-capped until delivery resumes.
currentPathsOrFormats: JSON LLM events encoded as server-sent events
256-event Tokio channel between the provider task and HTTP response
legacyPathsOrFormats: The existing SSE event shapes and terminal done/error events remain unchanged
outOfScopeClaims: This change does not make disconnected streams resumable.
This change does not move generation or persistence orchestration into Rust.
This change does not alter prompts, providers, chat records, or roleplay records.

contractLaneGate.brokenContract: The hostable runtime treated a full 256-event SSE channel as sse_stream_error and aborted the upstream provider stream when a sleeping phone stopped reading.
contractLaneGate.consumer: Remote browser Conversation and Roleplay generation
contractLaneGate.impliedContract: Temporary client backpressure may delay event delivery but must not cancel an otherwise healthy generation.
contractLaneGate.actualEnforcement: The HTTP adapter keeps the bounded network channel and stores only overflow events in a 4 MiB byte-capped FIFO backlog, flushing them before the terminal result once the reader resumes.
contractLaneGate.primaryOwnerDetail: src-tauri/src/http_server.rs owns the dedicated /api/llm/stream SSE adapter.
contractLaneGate.wrongLaneFixToAvoid: Do not retry or duplicate a user turn in Conversation/Roleplay UI, hide the failure, or restore an unbounded channel.
regressionProof: With the old full-channel error restored, llm_sse_backlog_preserves_events_while_receiver_is_stalled fails on the second event with sse_stream_error: no available capacity.
With the backlog limit disabled, llm_sse_backlog_keeps_stalled_reader_memory_bounded fails because the unsafe payload is accepted.
Both focused tests and all 77 http_server tests pass with the final adapter.

positiveRows.claim: A full SSE channel retains start, token, token, and done events until the reader resumes.
positiveRows.evidence: llm_sse_backlog_preserves_events_while_receiver_is_stalled uses a one-event channel and asserts the decoded SSE event sequence after flushing.

positiveRows.claim: Conversation and Roleplay share the repaired lower-level transport without mode orchestration changes.
positiveRows.evidence: Only the dedicated Rust /api/llm/stream adapter changed; TypeScript mode, generation, prompt, and persistence files are untouched.

contradictionRows.claim: Stalled readers must not regain unbounded memory growth.
contradictionRows.evidence: llm_sse_backlog_keeps_stalled_reader_memory_bounded rejects a backlog beyond 4 MiB with sse_stream_backlog_overflow.

contradictionRows.claim: A disconnected reader is not falsely reported as recoverable.
contradictionRows.evidence: Closed channels still return sse_stream_error; resumable jobs are explicitly outside this PR claim.

legacyDefaultRows.claim: Active readers preserve the existing streaming path and event contract.
legacyDefaultRows.evidence: Events still enter the same 256-event ReceiverStream immediately when capacity is available, and all existing http_server tests pass.

untestedRows: A real phone lock/unlock cycle against the exact merged Pi image is completed after deployment.
An OS-killed tab or dropped TCP connection remains outside scope.

ownedFacts.description: The pre-fix LLM SSE adapter called try_send and mapped a full channel to sse_stream_error.
ownedFacts.evidence: The pre-fix src-tauri/src/http_server.rs callback and the deterministic red test both produce no available capacity.

ownedFacts.description: The shared SSE channel is bounded at 256 events.
The live Pi was healthy but still running image revision 8342732f4691d9ba7f879b4857896a070936324a before this PR.
ownedFacts.evidence: Live /health?probe=1 and Docker image-label inspection before shipping.

manualBlockers.item: Post-merge locked-phone Conversation and Roleplay sample on the matching Pi image
manualBlockers.reason: The bounded backpressure contract is deterministic locally; exact device behavior requires the merged ARM64 image.

edgeRowsTested: One-event channel fills before the second LLM event
Reader resumes after start, two tokens, and done are queued
negativeRowsTested: Old queue-full behavior fails with sse_stream_error
Disabled byte cap accepts an unsafe backlog and fails the safety test
Final backlog preserves FIFO event order
All existing http_server tests remain green
